causalDomains.signal: 45% of fatalities are pedestrians — among the highest shares globally.
causalDomains.opportunity: Geofenced low-speed autonomous shuttles, intelligent crossings, connected infrastructure and protective ADAS can be targeted precisely where pedestrian exposure concentrates.
causalDomains.risk: High-exposure zones are also the most complex perception environments.

causalDomains.signal: National RTMC trend analyses typically show elevated night/holiday fatalities.
causalDomains.opportunity: L3/4 operation can be restricted to daylight ODD first — a strategic sequencing advantage, not a weakness.
causalDomains.risk: Night ODD remains a validation gap.

causalDomains.signal: Heavy-vehicle involvement widespread across N-corridor network; per-corridor crash data awaited.
causalDomains.opportunity: Corridor trucking safety analytics is a viable near-term service product.
causalDomains.risk: Long-haul fatigue and overload trends need measurement.

causalDomains.signal: Pedestrians dominant; cyclists/motorcyclists/jaywalking data not yet consolidated.
causalDomains.opportunity: Perception benchmarks for PED/cyclist detection can become a South African validation asset.
causalDomains.risk: No local public detection benchmark dataset yet exists (data moat).
